roster.name: Zond 5
roster.note: first spacecraft to circle the Moon and return safely to Earth — its two tortoises were the first living creatures to travel to the Moon's vicinity and back, three months before Apollo 8

roster.name: N1 — four launch failures
roster.note: every one of the four N1 test launches (1969-1972) failed; the second, in July 1969, fell back onto the pad in one of the largest non-nuclear explosions ever recorded

roster.name: LK lunar lander
roster.note: the single-cosmonaut lander — half the mass of Apollo's LM — flight-tested uncrewed in Earth orbit but never flown to the Moon

roster.name: L3 complex
roster.note: the full N1-L3 lunar stack: one N1 launch, a two-cosmonaut Soyuz 7K-LOK in lunar orbit, a single cosmonaut to the surface in the LK
